purpose: Bind global teacher and selected KV geometry from every actual ordinary TP/PP rank before capture buffer ownership is assigned

interfaces.bind_rank_target_contract: Checks actual PP group/local layers, native QKV TP placement, local KV shapes/dtypes, artifacts and output semantics; returns serializable rank-local evidence with global head geometry.
interfaces.RankTargetContract: Strict metadata for one serving TP/PP rank. Includes selected local layers even when its replicated heads will not own Store payloads.
interfaces.assemble_target_contract: Requires every expected serving rank, common immutable teacher identity and codec/storage parameters, complete PP intervals, and actual head ranges matching canonical ownership. Returns teacher, global KVSpec and CaptureLayout.
interfaces.bind_target_contract: Existing single-rank entry point now uses rank inspection and global assembly, shared by capture and the DSpark target-KV injector.

assertions: Only local PP layers are inspected; other stages have inaccessible placeholders.
All serving ranks must report, including inactive replicas and a final stage with no selected KV.
Actual projection rank/group/geometry and local K/V shapes must agree.
Every selected layer uses global KV head count and observed logical local head range.
Missing/duplicate/foreign ranks, changed selected order and inconsistent dtype/page/chunk parameters cannot form a global contract.
Artifact or output-transform changes cannot join an existing identity; expected revision pins are enforced locally.
Replica geometry, head ranges and RoPE/norm semantics must agree.
PP gaps, incomplete model coverage and inconsistent stage bounds fail.
limits: Distributed rank-record transport, collective startup error agreement, request admission, global teacher top-128/LSE and scheduler wiring remain pending. Serving TP/PP/DP gates stay closed.
TP4/PP3 tests inspect real native projection metadata in synthetic containers; they do not execute distributed model inference.
Only ordinary dense, unquantized BF16/FP16 NHD pools with standard RoPE are admitted. Query/KV TP groups must match.
Artifact hashes assume immutable local model/tokenizer files corresponding to the loaded model. Live device parameters and online weight replacement are not validated here.
No new RDMA, production Catalog, consumer, trained-draft quality or throughput/SLO claim.
Runtime integration is TP1/PP1 on one H100 with a synthetic KV-input draft and local TCP Store. The existing optional cross-engine HF KV diagnostic gate is not enabled.
